description: Discover bands and solo performers across all 50 US states, Washington, DC, and British Columbia by name keyword, home state, home city, genre, or touring tier — useful for finding local support acts, peer bands, or exact artist names before calling find_by_performer or find_similar_venues. Full dossiers require All Access; signed-in free accounts receive aggregate counts.

activity_tier.description: Optional activity tier filter: "local" (emerging + active local), "touring" (regional + national), or an exact tier ("emerging_local", "active_local", "regional_touring", "national_represented").

query.description: Optional performer name keyword or prefix.

state.description: Optional home state/jurisdiction code (all 50 US states, "DC", "BC") or full name.

name: search_performers
title: Search Bands & Local Support Acts
